subject: physics

hotspots.label: Box
hotspots.description: The 300 J load the belt raises when you choose how fast to work.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm amber crate riding the lift.
hotspots.function: Carries the work whose speed becomes power.

hotspots.label: Lift Belt
hotspots.description: Raises the box the same 1 m height, at whatever tempo you set.
hotspots.function: Performs the lifting work in time.

hotspots.label: Speed Knob
hotspots.description: Turns SLOW or FAST; quick runs raise the watt readout while the work stays equal.
hotspots.colorHint: A rounded green knob on a pedestal.
hotspots.function: Selects the time that divides the work.

hotspots.label: Watt Meter
hotspots.description: Green gauge in watts; the power = work ÷ time result, rising as speed rises.
hotspots.function: Shows the power output in watts.

hotspots.label: Work Total
hotspots.description: The fixed work counter — it reads the same joules across slow and fast lifts.
hotspots.colorHint: A slim warm display under the watt dial.
hotspots.function: Keeps the work denominator of the power formula visible.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper background, soft vignette. An open-air lifting rig, warm amber crate, blue-grey belt, green watt dial.
materialNotes: Metallic=0, roughness ~0.5. Belt slightly textured, crate warm amber. No emissive; the dial has a pale green face.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: power = work ÷ time on a lift belt.

GEOMETRY: vertical belt frame with a 1 kg crate; a speed knob; a watt meter; a work total.

INTERACTION: the knob sets lift speed; each cycle lifts the same 300 J load and the watt dial recomputes work ÷ time; work total stays 300 J.

NAMED NODES: Box, Belt, SpeedKnob, WattMeter, WorkTotal. 7-9k tris.
